critic.summary: Accepted. The fields wiring is fixed: home_fields is back to `always: fields_harvest_day`, which now serves locals too, with the giver framed by `{at_home(): …|…}`. The two neighbour-work cards are retired, so nothing repeats on every visit and nobody gets field work twice on one visit. The coordinator was right that `since(fields_harvest_day) > 0` counts months and could never hold during a break, so retiring both cards is the better fix. Every round-1 and round-2 issue is resolved. Lint shows no errors; zh-CN is still to fill. One optional polish point remains.

issues.problem: Optional polish: right v3 says 'He charges you less than last time', which assumes the player bought smoked eel at an earlier showing. A player who always helped with the traps never did.
issues.fix: Make it 'He charges you the price for people he knows, and won't say why the inn doesn't buy from him.', or key it on a flag set by the purchase.
